claims.text: For every bigrassmannian \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\) in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]

The source identifies the right-adjoined family as the conjugate family and notes that transposition would prove its minimality, without stating that result as a corollary. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]
The involution \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\) is a ring involution and preserves Littlewood–Richardson coefficients under partition conjugation. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 481-491]
